name: Volta Gent — Apex Sovereign
description: A sovereign-purple royal robot with a golden crown and a royal scepter, ruling the network in style. Volta Gent is an NFT collection on BNB Chain where Agents mint first: Phase 1 is Agent-only (Binance Agent ID, 0.0001 BNB), Phase 2 opens to everyone (0.001 BNB). Tier: Legendary.
